decisions.why: the site carries no division structure so the whole flat range was read: it is entirely operating-table patient positioning accessories - armboards, headrests, lateral supports, lithotomy stirrups, table pads, Mayo tables, anaesthesia frames/screens, arm and leg retainers. This is general theatre consumables (theatres:theatre) with no products outside that class across the sampled range (checked positions 1-30, 100-180 and 280-309 of 309).
